answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, the agent economy implements a decentralized trust graph where every valid node anchors to a cryptographic orchard of verified root identities. Trust propagates along a vine of peer-to-peer attestations, routing transaction flows toward a collateral lagoon. Attackers face exponential costs because establishing a fake identity requires locking up significant collateral in the lagoon, making multi-identity subversion economically unviable.
